parties.respondent: Saptashrungi Mahila Nagari Sahkari Patasanstha Ltd.

summary: Cheque dishonour under Section 138 NI Act; suppression of material facts in complaint; demand for loan documents not furnished; presumption under Section 139 NI Act; abuse of process alleged; High Court upheld issuance of process; issue of whether complaint liable to be quashed for suppression; standard of prima facie case at pre-trial stage; necessity of full disclosure in complaint proceedings.
legal_provisions_cited: S.P. Chengalvaraya Naidu v. Jagannath & Ors.
